# Task Tool Invocation

Subagent type: explorer
Task complexity: heavy
Task description: Map ops and tools surface

## Context
Use supplied context as authoritative. Do not repeat completed work or re-read supplied files unless writing them.
Stay within this assignment; if blocked, report the gap.

## Task
---BEGIN TASK FROM PARENT AGENT---
Investigate /root/hevy-mcp to inventory the full domain surface that should be covered by an Effect operations layer, and how MCP tools map to it.

Specifically:
1. List all Hevy client methods/resources (workouts, routines, templates, folders, body measurements, workout events, mutations, etc.) from hevy-client and generated API.
2. List all MCP tools in packages/core/src/tools/ and what each does (read/write, pagination, multi-step).
3. Map tool -> current data path (direct client, operations, catalog/cache, hand-rolled loops).
4. Identify high-complexity hand-rolled logic: pagination loops, date arithmetic, concurrency (Promise.all), custom caches, retry, abort handling.
5. Note existing response contracts, error policies, ToolRuntime patterns workers must preserve.
6. Note test patterns for tools and operations (file locations, mocking style).

Return a structured inventory with file paths. Do NOT modify anything.
---END TASK FROM PARENT AGENT---
I'll inventory the Hevy client surface, MCP tools, and how they connect through operations—starting with the code graph guidance and package layout.

# entire-graph — instructions for coding agents (follow directly)

You have a deterministic local code graph: `entire graph` (functions, classes, methods,
types, routes + call/inheritance relations; no network). These instructions are FOR YOU, the
agent reading this file. Use the graph to narrow exploration without trading away correctness.

## The workflow (mandatory for locate/fix/change tasks)

Your FIRST action on any task that requires finding code must be ONE search:

    entire graph search --repo . --profile full --query "<the task or bug in one sentence>"

Then open the top hit's file with your file-read tool (pass a line range around the reported
line), inspect enough surrounding behavior to justify the change, and make the smallest complete
edit. Treat graph output as evidence, not an oracle.

## Hard rules

1. SEARCH FIRST — never grep/find/cat to locate code before you have searched.
2. READ focused source around the result. Widen the check when aliases, generated code, dynamic
   dispatch, or related implementations could matter.
3. Use graph follow-ups only when they answer a real question. For impact or callers, prefer:
       entire graph impact --repo . --symbol X
4. Make the smallest complete edit and check sibling sites or contracts when the task implies them.
5. VERIFY before stopping. Run the most focused relevant test, build, or reproduction available.
   If execution is unavailable, perform a bounded source-level verification and state the limit.
6. Prefer precise queries and line ranges, but never trade resolution for fewer turns.
7. Feature-detect before relying on semantic relations:
       entire graph capabilities --json

## When NOT to use the graph

If the task already names the exact file and it is small, just read it — the graph saves tokens
by eliminating exploration; when there is nothing to explore, skip it.

## Reference

    locate  ->  entire graph search --repo . --profile full --query "..."
    impact  ->  entire graph impact --repo . --symbol X   (one shot: callers, callees, type consumers, data flow, co-change, siblings)
    callers ->  entire graph neighbors --repo . --symbol X --relation CALLS --direction in
    change  ->  entire graph diff --base A --head B --json
    detect  ->  entire graph capabilities --json   (inventory-only languages have no relations)
    stats   ->  entire graph stats --repo .        (human-facing token-savings report; not part of your workflow — do not run it unless asked)

# Domain surface inventory: client → operations → MCP tools

## 1. Hevy client / generated API surface

**Curated client:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/hevy-client.ts` (`HevyClient`, lines 48–136)  
**Generated endpoints:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/generated/client/api/`

| Domain | Client method | Generated API | HTTP |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workouts | `getWorkouts` | `getV1Workouts.ts` | GET `/v1/workouts` (page, pageSize) |
| Workouts | `getWorkout` | `getV1WorkoutsWorkoutid.ts` | GET `/v1/workouts/{id}` |
| Workouts | `createWorkout` | `postV1Workouts.ts` | POST `/v1/workouts` |
| Workouts | `updateWorkout` | `putV1WorkoutsWorkoutid.ts` | PUT `/v1/workouts/{id}` |
| Workouts | `getWorkoutCount` | `getV1WorkoutsCount.ts` | GET `/v1/workouts/count` |
| Workouts | `getWorkoutEvents` | `getV1WorkoutsEvents.ts` | GET `/v1/workouts/events` (page, pageSize, since) |
| Routines | `getRoutines` | `getV1Routines.ts` | GET `/v1/routines` |
| Routines | `getRoutineById` | `getV1RoutinesRoutineid.ts` | GET `/v1/routines/{id}` |
| Routines | `createRoutine` | `postV1Routines.ts` | POST `/v1/routines` |
| Routines | `updateRoutine` | `putV1RoutinesRoutineid.ts` | PUT `/v1/routines/{id}` |
| Templates | `getExerciseTemplates` | `getV1ExerciseTemplates.ts` | GET `/v1/exercise_templates` |
| Templates | `getExerciseTemplate` | `getV1ExerciseTemplatesExercisetemplateid.ts` | GET `/v1/exercise_templates/{id}` |
| Templates | `getExerciseHistory` | `getV1ExerciseHistoryExercisetemplateid.ts` | GET `/v1/exercise_history/{id}` |
| Templates | `createExerciseTemplate` | `postV1ExerciseTemplates.ts` | POST `/v1/exercise_templates` |
| Folders | `getRoutineFolders` | `getV1RoutineFolders.ts` | GET `/v1/routine_folders` |
| Folders | `getRoutineFolder` | `getV1RoutineFoldersFolderid.ts` | GET `/v1/routine_folders/{id}` |
| Folders | `createRoutineFolder` | `postV1RoutineFolders.ts` | POST `/v1/routine_folders` |
| Body | `getBodyMeasurements` | `getV1BodyMeasurements.ts` | GET `/v1/body_measurements` |
| Body | `getBodyMeasurement` | `getV1BodyMeasurementsDate.ts` | GET `/v1/body_measurements/{date}` |
| Body | `createBodyMeasurement` | `postV1BodyMeasurements.ts` | POST `/v1/body_measurements` |
| Body | `updateBodyMeasurement` | `putV1BodyMeasurementsDate.ts` | PUT `/v1/body_measurements/{date}` |
| User | `getUserInfo` | `getV1UserInfo.ts` | GET `/v1/user` |

**Client infra (not domain methods):** retry/abort/deadline in `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/execution.ts`, `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/retry-schedule.ts`, `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/endpoint-policy.ts`, Effect request path via `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/internal-request-effect.ts`.

---

## 2. Current Effect operations layer

**Package:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/operations/src/`

| Operation ID | File | Adapter methods | Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workouts.list` | `workouts.ts` | `getWorkouts` | Normalize page; catch expected end-of-list 404 |
| `workouts.get` | `workouts.ts` | `getWorkout` | Map response; catch expected not-found 404 |
| `routines.list` | `routines.ts` | `getRoutines` | Same list pattern |
| `routines.get` | `routines.ts` | `getRoutineById` | Same get pattern |

**Factory:** `createOperations(client)` in `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/operations/src/index.ts` — lazy `HevyRequestEffectClient` for only those four methods.  
**404 classification:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/operations/src/operation-errors.ts` (endpoints `/v1/workouts`, `/v1/routines` only).

**Gap:** No operations yet for events, count, mutations, templates, folders, body measurements, user, multi-page scans, search, or catalog.

---

## 3. MCP tools inventory + data path map

**Registration:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/register.ts` → `hevyToolDefinitions` (user tools **not** included).  
**Definition/wiring:** `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/define-tool.js` — validate args → `execute(runtime, args)` → `respond(contract, result)` → `runtime.createHandler` (error + telemetry).

### Registered tools (22)

| Tool | File | Kind | Complexity | Data path |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get-workouts` | `workouts.ts` | read / list / page | single page | **operations** `workouts.list` via `HevyOperationsService` |
| `get-workout` | `workouts.ts` | read / get | single | **operations** `workouts.get` |
| `get-workout-events` | `workouts.ts` | read / sync / page | single page + local 404 catch | **direct client** `getWorkoutEvents` |
| `create-workout` | `workouts.ts` | write / create | single | **direct client** `createWorkout` |
| `update-workout` | `workouts.ts` | write / update | **multi-step RMW** | **direct client** `getWorkout` → `buildWorkoutUpdatePayload` → `updateWorkout` |
| `replace-workout-exercises` | `workouts.ts` | write / update | **multi-step RMW** | same as update, with exercise replacement |
| `get-routines` | `routines.ts` | read / list / page | single page | **operations** `routines.list` |
| `get-routine` | `routines.ts` | read / get | single | **operations** `routines.get` |
| `create-routine` | `routines.ts` | write / create | payload build | **mutation-semantics** + **direct client** `createRoutine` |
| `update-routine` | `routines.ts` | write / update | payload build (full replace semantics) | **mutation-semantics** + **direct client** `updateRoutine` |
| `get-exercise-template` | `templates.ts` | read / get | single + 404 | **direct client** `getExerciseTemplate` |
| `get-exercise-history` | `templates.ts` | read / get | optional date bounds | **direct client** `getExerciseHistory` |
| `create-exercise-template` | `templates.ts` | write / create | single | **direct client** `createExerciseTemplate` |
| `search-exercise-templates` | `templates.ts` | read / search | filter over full catalog | **catalog/cache** `ExerciseTemplateCatalogService` (not list API page) |
| `get-routine-folder` | `folders.ts` | read / get | single + 404 | **direct client** `getRoutineFolder` |
| `create-routine-folder` | `folders.ts` | write / create | single | **direct client** `createRoutineFolder` |
| `get-body-measurements` | `body-measurements.ts` | read / list / page | single page + 404 | **direct client** `getBodyMeasurements` |
| `get-body-measurement` | `body-measurements.ts` | read / get | single + 404 | **direct client** `getBodyMeasurement` |
| `create-body-measurement` | `body-measurements.ts` | write / create | payload omit-nulls | **mutation-semantics** + **direct client** |
| `update-body-measurement` | `body-measurements.ts` | write / update | empty-payload guard | **mutation-semantics** + **direct client** |
| `get-training-summary` | `workflows.ts` | read / workflow | **multi-page + date window + concurrent scans** | **hand-rolled** `scanPagesInWindow` + `Promise.all` on **direct client** workouts + body measurements |
| `search-routines` | `routine-discovery.ts` | read / search | **multi-page filter loop** | **hand-rolled** pagination on **direct client** `getRoutines` |

### Defined but not registered as a tool

| Tool | File | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `get-user-info` | `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/user.ts` | Implemented + tested; **not** in `hevyToolDefinitions`. Exposed only as resource `hevy://user`. |

### MCP resources (non-tool domain surface)

`/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/resources/hevy.ts`:

| Resource URI | Client / path |
|---|---|
| `hevy://user` | direct `getUserInfo` |
| `hevy://workout-count` | direct `getWorkoutCount` (**no tool**) |
| `hevy://exercise-templates` | catalog `fetchAllPages(getExerciseTemplates)` + TTL cache |
| `hevy://routine-folders` | hand-rolled `fetchAllPages(getRoutineFolders)` (**list folders has no tool**) |

### Prompts (guided, not data ops)

`/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/prompts/workouts.ts` — e.g. `analyze-workout-progress`; observation-wrapped, not client calls.

---

## 4. High-complexity hand-rolled logic

| Location | Pattern | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/workflows.ts` | Pagination loop `scanPagesInWindow`; UTC date window (`parseUtcDate`, `getPeriod`, exclusive end day); `Promise.all` dual scan; session/measurement aggregation | Caps pageSize 10; sequential pages per stream; concurrent streams |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/routine-discovery.ts` | `while` page loop until `limit`; title filter | pageSize 10; no ops layer |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/utils/pagination.ts` | generic `fetchAllPages` | used by catalog + routine-folders resource |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/utils/exercise-template-catalog.ts` | `AsyncTtlCache` (5 min, max 1 key); `fetchAllPages` pageSize 100; refresh reasons; optional abort/deadline; in-flight sharing | search-exercise-templates + resource |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/utils/cache.ts` | TTL cache primitive | catalog only in domain path |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/mutation-semantics.ts` | Workout RMW; ISO→second-precision timestamp normalize; `is_private` quirk; routine rep_range create vs update; measurement omit-nulls; `mergeMeasurementPayload` (CLI-oriented) | Quirk text: `hevy-quirks.ts` |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/workouts.ts` | Local try/catch end-of-list for events | Same policy as ops, not shared through ops |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/body-measurements.ts` | Local list/get 404 policy | Candidate for ops parity with workouts/routines |
| `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/hevy-client/src/*` | Retry schedule, backoff, abort/deadline, operation safety, mutation 404 policy | Below tools; ops reuses Effect client path |

---

## 5. Patterns workers/adapters must preserve

### ToolRuntime (`/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/tools/tool-runtime.ts`)
- Services: `HevyClientService`, `HevyOperationsService`, `ExerciseTemplateCatalogService`, optional `ToolObserverService` (`effect-services.ts` / `effect-layer.ts`).
- `createOperations(rawClient)` when ops not injected.
- `forExecution(context)`: bind client execution, merge lifecycle + request abort, set deadline from timeout.
- `createHandler` = `withErrorHandling` (+ observation when observer present).
- Safe telemetry arg keys only (page/limit/ids/presence/booleans) — no payloads.

### define-tool (`define-tool.ts`)
- Read tools require `outputSchema`; writes optional.
- Always: `responseContract` + `respond(...)`.
- Taxonomy: `feature`, `kind` (`read`|`write`), `operation`.

### Response contracts (`/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/utils/response-contracts.ts`)
- Structured reads: Zod `outputSchema`, normalize/project, legacy JSON text, empty-state text, result telemetry buckets, `expected404Outcome`.
- Writes: mostly `defineJsonResponseContract` (create/update workout/folder/template/measurement); create-routine is structured with `uses_rep_ranges` + warning text.
- Workflow contracts attach `scan` + workflow telemetry (`training-summary`, `routine-discovery`).
- Pagination shape: `page`, `page_count`, `has_next_page`.

### Error policy
- Tool: `error-handler.ts` + `error-policy.ts` via `withErrorHandling`.
- Hevy 404 helpers: `hevy-error-policy.ts` (`isExpectedReadNotFound`, `isExpectedListPageNotFound`, mutation 404).
- Ops: `operation-errors.ts` (stricter endpoint-scoped).
- Client: endpoint policy + retry classification.

### Server composition (`server.ts`)
- Catalog + tools + prompts + resources on one runtime; Worker/Node must keep that boundary.

---

## 6. Test patterns

### Tools (`packages/core/src/tools/*.test.ts`)
- Co-located per domain: `workouts.test.ts`, `routines.test.ts`, `templates.test.ts`, `folders.test.ts`, `body-measurements.test.ts`, `workflows.test.ts`, `routine-discovery.test.ts`, `user.test.ts`, `tool-runtime.test.ts`, `register.test.ts`, `mutation-semantics.test.ts`, …
- Fixture: `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/test-fixtures/mock-hevy.ts` — `createMockHevyClient()` (vi.fn per method) + `createMockMcpServer()`.
- Pattern: register definitions → grab handler from mock `registerTool` → call with snake_case args → assert client/ops calls and structured responses.
- Ops injection tests (e.g. workouts): stub `HevyOperations` execute fns; assert execution context forwarded.
- Catalog tests: `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/utils/exercise-template-catalog.test.ts`, `pagination.test.ts`, `cache.test.ts`.
- Resources: `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts`.

### Operations (`packages/operations/src/*.test.ts`)
- In-memory Effect adapters (`Effect.succeed` / `Effect.fail`), not full HTTP.
- `HevyHttpError` for 404 end-of-list / not-found.
- Abort/signal coverage via Effect callbacks.
- `public-client-injection.test.ts` for `createOperations` wiring.
- `operation-errors.test.ts`, `effect-collapse.test.ts`.

### CLI also exercises domain (not MCP tools)
- `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/cli/src/commands/index.ts` already uses ops for workout/routine list/get and direct client + shared mutation builders for the rest — useful second consumer of any expanded ops layer.

---

## 7. Coverage matrix (ops-layer candidates)

| Domain capability | Client | Ops today | MCP tool | Resource | Primary complexity to absorb |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Workouts list/get | yes | **yes** | yes | — | page normalize + 404 |
| Workout events | yes | no | yes | — | page + since + 404 |
| Workout count | yes | no | **no** | yes | single get |
| Workout create/update/replace | yes | no | yes | — | RMW + quirks + timestamps |
| Routines list/get | yes | **yes** | yes | — | page normalize + 404 |
| Routines create/update | yes | no | yes | — | rep_range payload |
| Routine search (multi-page) | via list | no | yes | — | scan + filter + limit |
| Templates get/history/create | yes | no | yes | — | 404 / date bounds |
| Templates list/catalog/search | yes | no | search tool | full catalog | TTL cache + fetchAllPages + filter |
| Folders get/create | yes | no | yes | — | 404 |
| Folders list-all | yes | no | **no** | yes | fetchAllPages |
| Body list/get/create/update | yes | no | yes | — | 404 + measurement payload |
| Body window scan | via list | no | via training-summary | — | date window pagination |
| Training summary | composite | no | yes | — | dual scan + date math + aggregation |
| User info | yes | no | defined unregistered | yes | single get |

---

## 8. Key file index

| Area | Paths |
|---|---|
| Client surface | `packages/hevy-client/src/hevy-client.ts`, `generated/client/api/*` |
| Ops | `packages/operations/src/{index,workouts,routines,operation-errors}.ts` |
| Tools | `packages/core/src/tools/{register,define-tool,tool-runtime,workouts,routines,templates,folders,body-measurements,workflows,routine-discovery,user,mutation-semantics,input-schemas,hevy-quirks,capabilities}.ts` |
| Contracts / policy | `packages/core/src/utils/{response-contracts,error-handler,error-policy,hevy-error-policy,pagination,exercise-template-catalog,cache,formatters,output-schemas}.ts` |
| Resources / server | `packages/core/src/resources/hevy.ts`, `packages/core/src/server.ts` |
| Tool tests | `packages/core/src/tools/*.test.ts`, `packages/core/test-fixtures/mock-hevy.ts` |
| Ops tests | `packages/operations/src/*.test.ts` |

**Bottom line:** Effect ops currently cover only **4 read ops** (workouts/routines list+get). Everything else on the domain surface is still **direct client**, **catalog/cache**, or **hand-rolled multi-page/date/concurrency** inside core tools/resources—especially `get-training-summary`, `search-routines`, template catalog, folder listing, and workout RMW mutations.
